title: Cost of selfishness in the allocation of cities in the Multiple Travelling Salesmen Problem
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'Cost of selfishness' in human organizations as modeled in an allocation problem. Selfishness is a concept fundamentally related to morals and ethics. By quantifying the 'cost' of this trait in different organizational mechanisms, the paper is evaluating the practical implications and consequences of an ethical characteristic within a system designed to model human behavior.
